subject: Temporary APAC analytics snapshot egress & KMS options
messages:
From: Alex Tan <alex.tan@finovalabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@finovalabs.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question: temporary APAC analytics snapshot egress + KMS BYOK options

Hi Sean,

Quick question as we scope the integration: our analytics team needs to capture short-lived model telemetry snapshots for a 48–72 hour window in APAC (ap-southeast-1) to validate latency and tokenization artifacts during our pilot. Can Redwood confirm whether hosted processing for analytics snapshots may be routed out of APAC in any circumstances (e.g., background analytics pipelines or model telemetry aggregation)?

Two follow-ups:
- Would Redwood agree to a contractual notice window before any temporary cross-border processing that touches Finova data (we're requesting 72 hours)?
- Does Redwood support customer-managed KMS keys for region-specific encryption (particularly if we move to Dedicated or Private)?

Also attaching our initial DPA redlines for reference. Could you loop in the right folks on your side (security/compliance + product infra)?

Thanks,
Alex
Product Ops | Finova Labs
[Attachment: Finova_DPA_redlines_20260610.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question: temporary APAC analytics snapshot egress + KMS BYOK options

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Soojin (privacy/infra) and Marissa (legal ops) to cover the details. High-level from my side:

- Redwood's hosted inference is region-aware and by default will process requests in the region you select (APAC/US/EU). We support region pinning for production workloads.
- For short-lived telemetry/analytics snapshots, we do have automated background pipelines that may aggregate anonymized metrics in a central analytics plane (currently in us-west-2) unless a customer requests residency pinning for analytics as well.

Proposed next steps:
1) Soojin will confirm the exact telemetry pipeline and whether snapshots would be processed outside APAC by default.
2) We can offer a contractual notification window for temporary cross-border processing — our standard internal practice has been 48 hours, but we can discuss 72 hours as a stronger commitment for Finova.
3) KMS BYOK: for Dedicated and Private we support customer-managed keys; for hosted we offer Bring-Your-Own-Key for encrypting stored artifacts under certain enterprise plans. I'll confirm specifics (key rotation, HSM integration) with Soojin.

Attached is a quick export of our currently disclosed subprocessors so you have visibility while we formalize the DPA changes.

Best,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Tan <alex.tan@finovalabs.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question: temporary APAC analytics snapshot egress + KMS BYOK options

Alex / team — quick technical note on what's involved so you can evaluate risk and contract terms.

1) Telemetry snapshots: these are ephemeral data captures (anonymized token-level stats + request timing) we use to diagnose regressions. By default the telemetry pipeline aggregates to a central analytics cluster (us-west-2) for cross-customer tooling and model ops. However, the raw request data stored in short-lived KV caches is kept in-region. The only cross-region movement would be for aggregated telemetry and non-production analytics jobs.

2) Temporary egress windows: operationally we can implement a \"territory-bound analytics\" flag for the APAC tenant which keeps aggregation jobs inside ap-southeast-1. For hosted customers we treat this as a configuration change requiring a 48–72 hour configuration and validation window. For Dedicated/Private customers we can supply a BYOK workflow and keep keys within your KMS in-region.

3) Logging and audit: when cross-region analytics happen we retain trace-level logs indicating source region, export window, and the operator who initiated it. We can map those logs to your Cloud Audit (if you share a logging sink) or provide a redacted audit export.

Suggested contractual language to address Alex's request: \"Provider will notify Customer at least 72 hours prior to any non-routine cross-border processing of Customer Data for analytics or diagnostic purposes; Customer shall have the option to decline or require in-region processing within 48 hours of notice.\"

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call to walk the engineering team through the pipeline.

— Soojin
Staff Engineer, Platform Privacy | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Tan <alex.tan@finovalabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@finovalabs.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 07:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question: temporary APAC analytics snapshot egress + KMS BYOK options

Thanks Sean / Soojin — that helps. A couple of quick asks from Legal before we proceed:

- Please confirm in writing that Finova will receive at least 72 hours' advance notice for any temporary cross-border analytics processing involving Finova data.
- We need an explicit option to require in-region processing (ap-southeast-1) with a 48-hour turnaround once notice is sent. If Redwood cannot guarantee in-region processing for hosted during certain cases, we need a fallback escalation path.
- Confirm whether Redwood's hosted BYOK option includes customer-provided KMS keys that are constrained to a region (we want assurance keys and decrypted artifacts will not leave ap-southeast-1).

I've attached the specific DPA redlines; please send a DocuSign amendment if you're able to accept the language.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Alex
Product Ops | Finova Labs
[Attachment: Finova_DPA_redlines_20260610.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Tan <alex.tan@finovalabs.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question: temporary APAC analytics snapshot egress + KMS BYOK options

Alex — good questions, and we can accommodate Finova's requests with the following commitments:

- Notification window: Redwood will provide at least 72 hours' advance written notice for any non-routine cross-border analytics processing that would move Finova data out of ap-southeast-1.

- In-region option & escalation: upon notice Finova will have the option to require in-region processing; Redwood will implement in-region processing within 48 hours of Finova's instruction where technically feasible. If the hosted environment cannot accommodate an immediate in-region enforcement, we will escalate to our Enterprise Ops team and provide a documented mitigation and timeline (including Dedicated/Private fast-path options).

- KMS BYOK: For Dedicated and Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS keys constrained to the requested region. For hosted BYOK we can offer key-wrapping scoped to APAC; we will include the specific contractual clause that encrypted artifacts and decrypted temporary analytics snapshots will not be exported outside ap-southeast-1.

Next steps:
- Marissa will prepare a DPA amendment reflecting the 72-hour notice and the in-region option language.
- I'll send a DocuSign amendment link and update the HubSpot deal (FIN-2026-0421).
- Soojin / Mina will be available for a technical review call to validate the implementation plan.
